scope: FR-PUBLISH-003 DeliveryAccessGrant download receipt identity, idempotency and revoke fail-closed behavior
red: A receipt could be recorded after grant revocation.
A repeated receipt request could mutate the original access timestamp.
An authorized download could bypass byte verification or fail to leave a receipt.
green: Receipts require a currently valid, non-revoked grant.
Receipts freeze artifact-set fingerprint and per-artifact byte identities.
The same receipt identity is immutable and idempotent.
Each download is byte-verified, returns the artifact MIME, and exposes a receipt identity; revoked grants fail closed.

result: 3 domain tests passed; 1 API integration test passed
boundary: Domain and HTTP download evidence is covered; production leak-scan, real recipient exercise and rollback drill remain open.
